train_models.help:
usage: train_models.py [-h] [--dataset-dir DATASET_DIR]
                       [--fold-manifest FOLD_MANIFEST] [--run-id RUN_ID]
                       [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE]
                       {preflight,smoke,tune}

KNN/DT HOG training in the existing algorithm-specific run directories. Run
from the repository root with data/.venv-model3/Scripts/python.exe. Existing
features, models, selections, test claims and reports are not overwritten.

positional arguments:
  {preflight,smoke,tune}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dataset-dir DATASET_DIR
  --fold-manifest FOLD_MANIFEST
  --run-id RUN_ID
  --batch-size BATCH_SIZE

options:

  --export-id EXPORT_ID

check_model_artifacts.help:
usage: check_model_artifacts.py [-h] --knn-run KNN_RUN --dt-run DT_RUN

options:

verify_models.help:
usage: verify_models.py [-h] --tag TAG [--baseline] [--notebook NOTEBOOK]
                        [--preservation-snapshot PRESERVATION_SNAPSHOT]
                        [--relocations RELOCATIONS]
                        [--allowed-change ALLOWED_CHANGE]

Record actual test/environment/notebook execution and preservation evidence.
Only new logs under logs/knn/verification-<tag> are written. The baseline
suite is not silently fixed if a historical person-2 test fails.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --tag TAG
  --baseline
  --notebook NOTEBOOK
  --preservation-snapshot PRESERVATION_SNAPSHOT
  --relocations RELOCATIONS
  --allowed-change ALLOWED_CHANGE
                        Explicit authorized refactor path; repeat for each
                        changed file

finalize_models.help:
usage: finalize_models.py [-h] --knn-run KNN_RUN --dt-run DT_RUN
                          --verification-tag VERIFICATION_TAG
                          [--notebook NOTEBOOK] [--source-root SOURCE_ROOT]
                          --preservation-snapshot PRESERVATION_SNAPSHOT
                          [--allowed-change ALLOWED_CHANGE]

Audit/export a new KNN/DT train-CV run and append results to their reports.
One-shot command: existing export/notebook/report markers are rejected. It
never trains, infers, removes claims, rewrites historical hashes, or edits
AI_USAGE.md.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --knn-run KNN_RUN
  --dt-run DT_RUN
  --verification-tag VERIFICATION_TAG
  --notebook NOTEBOOK
  --source-root SOURCE_ROOT
  --preservation-snapshot PRESERVATION_SNAPSHOT
  --allowed-change ALLOWED_CHANGE
